sourceSentences: [0] Zilean, I think it's a very bad champion, very good win rate later on in the game.

[0] Zilean and Sona don't have really good lane phase. They will get hard bullied against most match-up, but they scale extremely well, very annoying to play against
[1] Lulu can deal more constant damage if she can deal with Zilean's Time Bomb (Q)- Rewind(W) - Time Bomb (Q) combo well.
[1] Zilean's Chronoshift(R) makes it difficult to kill enemies, cast Whimsy[W] to prevent the enemy from dealing damage
[1] kill them as soon as Chronoshift(R) wears off.
[1] However, if the enemy poses a threat, kill them quickly when they have Chronoshift(R) and escape while they are reviving.
[2] Avoid Lulu's (Q) by using [E] while dealing damage.
[2] Use [Q]-[W]-[Q] to stun Lulu when she tries to use a basic attack.
[3] Zilean has a really bad laning phase so you'll want to play aggressive against him.
[3] Dodge double Q bomb and there should be no other threat.
[3] You ideally want to play for a lead prio to 6 when he can negative a death
[3] If Zilean throws two Q bombs next to each other, they instantly explode & apply stun.
[3] Stand away from allies when marked by a bomb.
[3] E has a long slow duration; try to stay away from his range to avoid it.
[3] Poke him constantly before Lvl.6 since he has no sustain.
[3] Wait for R to wear off before attacking the bearer.
